assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Atherosclerotic heart disease is coded I25.10
Nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency is coded I34.0
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring was ordered
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring is coded CPT 93229
The service was ordered to correlate transient symptoms with potential arrhythmic events or ischemic changes that may not be captured on standard ambulatory monitoring
The service is medically necessary to evaluate the recurrent syncope and near-syncope episodes in a patient with established cardiovascular disease
The service is supported by documented clinical indications
